environment: Exact GitHub Actions run 35231725193 artifacts for candidate 0ad125c3e0b7e10cc09c862c668985d06a7c41f2; disposable SQLite/PostgreSQL test state; Playwright Chromium; desktop and 360/390/430 CSS-pixel portrait evidence; exact hosted lifecycle, controls, readability, opening and full-chapter browser gates.
limitations: No blind novice/young-player study or physical-phone test. Reviewer knew product/source context. WebAudio lifecycle, scheduling, phases and mute/pause were verified, but this environment cannot literally listen to the music/effects mix; subjective audio appeal is reserved for the user's final review. Immediate transfer is observed, not delayed retention or mastery.
prior_context: Reviewer knew the Level 1 design and prior preview failures before inspecting the exact candidate. Counterexamples therefore target known abandonment risks, the original retained-button-focus movement bug, browser autoplay constraints, and adversarial state choices rather than claiming a blind first-time study.
user_authority: The current user is the sole final product critic. This record can only recommend an exact candidate for their review; it cannot accept the game for them.
design_direction: A real learning game: Bellweather story entry -> separate tutorial -> guaranteed first success -> changed-context Level 1 challenge -> recoverable mistake -> fresh transfer -> persistent-world payoff, with direct third-person control and reusable WorldSpec/runtime foundations.

world_role_stakes.reason: The exact opening evidence establishes Bellweather, Zip at home, rupture, isolation, prison, speech theft and the repair/escape objective before tutorial play.
world_role_stakes.counterexample_attempt: Ignored prior product knowledge and inspected only the staged opening plus concise captions; role, loss and immediate objective remain legible.

visible_causality.reason: Story rupture, speech theft, tutorial repair, stale-route failure and corrected Star-route completion all have visible world/state consequences, including reduced-motion evidence.
visible_causality.counterexample_attempt: Checked reduced-motion variants and the deliberate wrong-route state to see whether causality depended on fast animation; the before/after state remains explicit.

attachment_pull.reason: The opening begins with Zip visibly situated in Bellweather among friends/home before rupture, creating a concrete emotional before/after anchor for isolation and lost speech.
attachment_pull.counterexample_attempt: Skimmed explanatory text and checked whether the home/friends-to-isolation contrast still reads from staging and scene order; it does.

orientation_action.reason: Fresh entry and tutorial progress from story controls to one dominant tutorial task at a time, followed by an explicit Begin Level 1 boundary; optional movement/camera tools do not replace the task action.
orientation_action.counterexample_attempt: Looked for competing required actions during fresh tutorial progression; no second required interaction competes with the highlighted task.

hud_readability.reason: The exact readability gate passes 200% text at 360/390/430, while the 360 completion evidence keeps the world, goal, generated command and completion actions usable.
hud_readability.counterexample_attempt: Inspected the densest 200%/360 states for a collapse into a reading page; the HUD is dense but remains bounded and game/world-first.

controls.reason: The exact controls gate proves WASD after save/reload even with a non-text game button retaining focus, plus accessible step movement, touch stick, touch drag-to-look, zoom and recenter; typing targets remain protected.
controls.counterexample_attempt: Reproduced the historically broken retained-button-focus condition after persisted reload; W now moves Zip without requiring a focus workaround.

meaningful_agency.reason: Choosing stale Moon context changes the generated command and produces the visible Wrong route state; recovery requires a new player choice rather than cosmetic acceptance.
meaningful_agency.counterexample_attempt: Deliberately reused the tutorial's Moon answer in Level 1; the world rejected it and preserved the failure state.

progression_recovery.reason: The chapter gives a separate guided success before the changed-context challenge, preserves the first wrong choice, and supports in-world recovery using the learned loop and current clue.
progression_recovery.counterexample_attempt: Failed the first unguided route challenge; recovery did not require restarting or erasing history and instead required applying the current clue.

world_continuity.reason: Opening, tutorial, failure/recovery and completion remain in one stateful PlayCanvas Bellweather/prison runtime; the completion payoff is a changed world/gate state rather than a detached result screen.
world_continuity.counterexample_attempt: Compared tutorial completion, wrong route and final completion looking for a quiz/page break; the same world and third-person control layer persist.

concept_fidelity.reason: The learned loop is context-conditioned word generation: a previously valid Moon context becomes wrong when the current route changes, while the current clue produces the Star command and world result.
concept_fidelity.counterexample_attempt: Reused the old context after the environmental context changed; the generated stale command fails, demonstrating the concept causally rather than only in prose.

fresh_transfer.reason: Level 1 defeats verbatim reuse of the tutorial's Moon answer and requires mapping the new five-point environmental clue/current context to a different Star-route solution.
fresh_transfer.counterexample_attempt: Tried the immediately practiced Moon solution unchanged; it creates Wrong route and must be repaired from fresh context.
